name: easyeda-pro-control
description: Safety-gated EasyEDA API coverage, fixed typed SDK reads, design operations and seven engineering skills.

interface.longDescription: Seven skills cover control, schematics, PCB layout, libraries, manufacturing, design review and extensions. Per-method inventory distinguishes fixed public calls, native equivalents, blocked implementations and omissions. The current reviewed tuple has separately pinned geometry calculations, environment/unit methods, extension-index and editor-shell observations, identity-only active document/project/branch observation, configured-shortcut enumeration without keyboard execution, and journaled ordinary existing-profile launch. Identity results contain no titles, paths or design content and grant no navigation or editing authority. Ordinary launch may load extensions and change cache/preferences; it does not prove isolation or bridge readiness. Missing installation files select offline-only startup. The older tuple retains guarded readers, footprint typed API operations, native controls, checkpoints and recovery. Schematic-page, symbol and PCB transactions plus eight metadata writers remain blocked pending native structure-job completion and full SQL-effect proof. Compiled topology and affected exports refuse hidden annotation or Save All. Historical evidence is generation-specific; declarations and matching samples do not prove complete source or saved state. Arbitrary JavaScript, blind retry and unrestricted Save remain refused; the legacy writer is runtime-disabled. The historical reviewed tuple is connected-read-admitted; future mismatches fail closed within each capability profile.
defaultPrompt: Validate the EasyEDA bridge without bypassing compatibility gates.
Inspect the admitted EasyEDA project with exact readers and managed evidence.
Apply the requested typed design change and verify it after saving and reopening.
